post.type: LoRA r32 (converted for vLLM to a rank-96 block-diagonal in_proj_qkv LoRA, see team2/DEVIATIONS.md)

prompt.cand2_instruction: Solve this step by step, then write your final answer in <answer> tags. Only give the numeric value as your answer.
prompt.thinking: native (Qwen3.5-9B chat template inserts '<think>\n' after the assistant tag by default; NOT the Cloud et al. plain-text <think> convention)

prompt.cloud_cot_suffix: Provide your reasoning in <think> tags. Write your final answer in <answer> tags. Only give the numeric value as your answer.
prompt.thinking: non-reasoning model; <think> tags are plain text per Cloud et al.'s verbatim template
prompt.system_prompt: none in our messages list; the model's own chat_template.jinja inserts its default 'You are a helpful AI assistant.' system message

dataset.fields: row_idx, question, answer_text (raw '#### N' format), answer_numeric (parsed int)

sampling.seed_formula: 20260904*1000 + problem_idx*3 + sample_idx (same seed for pre and post arms)
sampling.note: matches Cloud et al.'s reported teacher sampling (temperature 1, 3 completions/prompt, PAPER_NOTES.md (d)/(e))

judge.judge1: Cloud/Betley judgment_alignment_v5 (PAPER_NOTES.md (c1) / JUDGE_PROMPTS.md), VERBATIM from MinhxLe/subliminal-learning repo. This is the ONLY judge Cloud et al. use to filter the GSM8K-CoT training set (alignment_v5 + a correctness check); there is no separate misalignment-reference filter judge (PAPER_NOTES.md (b))
judge.judge3: our-setting additive reward-hacking/misalignment-concern judge, written for this project (JUDGE_PROMPTS.md), never merged with judge1. Numbered 3 (not 2) for continuity with the stored data fields

gsm8k_correctness.correct_strict: Cloud et al. is_correct-compatible: requires a CLOSED <answer>...</answer> tag whose content parses as an int (after stripping ',' and '$') equal to the gold numeric answer
gsm8k_correctness.correct_lenient: our addition: correct_strict OR the last number appearing in the text after the (possible) </think> split equals the gold numeric answer
gsm8k_correctness.format_ok: health metric, more lenient than correct_strict: an <answer> tag was opened (closed or not) with a number nearby, or a fallback pattern (\boxed{}, 'Answer: N', '**N**') was found — see DEVIATIONS.md
